snippet.title: Scrub Dudes - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Scrub Dudes is a cleaning game where you wash a handcrafted-style world, collect trash, and fix objects together with a penguin and a pug. Using two different camera perspectives, you will heavily rely on climbing and gliding in order to find and clean all the dirt throughout the environment.

Wishlist Scrub Dudes on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4241300/Scrub_Dudes/
